mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies over Fireman Park with a temperature of 77 degrees and an air quality index of 52.
City officials remind everyone to ensure mailboxes are in good repair to survive upcoming plowing, and students are invited to submit designs for a new local I Voted sticker by July 22.
We have plenty to look forward to including Yoga at Insight Wellness today, Concerts in the Park today, and Hop Haus Trivia also happening today.
Turning to our police report, on July 14, an officer stopped a vehicle for driving without headlights and subsequently cited the occupants for drug-related offenses and a firearm violation.
Today is the perfect time to enjoy the Really Reese's flavor of the day, so head over to Culver's before they close at 10 PM tonight.
